items.name: Wallet and Payment Balance Synchronization Issues
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in Wallet, Booking
items.root_cause: Wallet transaction idempotency key collision causing duplicate deductions. UPI gateway callback replay causing double wallet credit. Wallet balance cache not invalidated after successful transactions.

items.name: Refund Processing Pipeline Delays
items.summary: Pattern detected: 3 related tickets in Refund
items.root_cause: Refund batch processor queue backlog due to insufficient worker capacity during promotional periods. Bank transfer reconciliation job failing on certain IFSC codes. Partial refund calculation logic incorrect for tiered service packages.

items.name: Beautician Scheduling and Availability Issues
items.summary: Pattern detected: 3 related tickets in Beautician
items.root_cause: Beautician schedule sync not updating in real-time from provider mobile app. Availability calendar cache TTL too long causing stale slot data. Notification service failing to deliver assignment alerts to beautician app.

items.name: Payment Processing and Booking Confirmation Failures
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in Booking, Payment
items.root_cause: Payment gateway callback handling race condition where booking creation fails after payment success. UPI transaction status check polling interval too long causing delayed confirmation. Duplicate charge protection not triggering on retry attempts.

items.name: Billing and Contract Management Discrepancies
items.summary: Pattern detected: 5 related tickets in Contract, Billing
items.root_cause: Contract auto-approval workflow missing escalation step for VP-level approvals. Billing system using stale contract terms due to synchronization delay. Partner commission calculation formula incorrect for tiered structures.

items.name: API Authentication and Integration Failures
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in API
items.root_cause: OAuth token refresh endpoint returning stale JWTs due to clock skew across auth servers. API rate limiter not distinguishing between partner tiers causing unfair throttling.

items.name: Partner Onboarding Workflow Stalls
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in Partner Onboarding
items.root_cause: Email delivery service rate-limited by partner domains. Verification token expiry window too short for multi-step onboarding. Bulk import processor crashes on partners with missing required fields.

items.name: CRM Partner Data Synchronization Failures
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in CRM Sync
items.root_cause: Salesforce API version upgrade changed account hierarchy field mappings. Partner portal cache invalidation not triggered after HubSpot deal updates. Concurrent sync operations causing deadlock on partner contact table.

items.name: Patient Record Data Integrity Issues
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in Patient, Lab Reports
items.root_cause: Patient merge tool not handling HL7 segment identifiers correctly causing duplicated records. PHI export encryption key rotation not triggering automated re-encryption. Date parsing library fails on non-US date formats in lab uploads.

items.name: Lab Results and Diagnostic Processing Pipeline
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in Lab Reports, Insurance
items.root_cause: Lab result alerting service not triggered when result values exceed critical thresholds. Reference lab HL7 feed parser fails on new message format version. Insurance verification service certificate expired.

items.name: E-Prescription Routing Failures
items.summary: Pattern detected: 3 related tickets in Prescription
items.root_cause: Pharmacy directory service returning stale NCPDP IDs causing routing failures. Prescription renewal queue processor crashes on malformed renewal request payloads.

items.name: Appointment Booking and Scheduling System Failures
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in Appointment, Doctor
items.root_cause: Appointment booking confirmation service disconnected from payment gateway callback. Slot availability cache not invalidating after bookings causing double-booking. OR scheduling module not receiving availability updates from surgery center system.

items.name: Data Pipeline and Analytics Processing Delays
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in Data Import, Analytics
items.root_cause: Data import queue backlog due to insufficient worker capacity during peak ingestion hours. Analytics materialized view refresh schedule conflicts with import window.

items.name: Webhook Delivery Reliability Issues
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in Webhook, CRM, Data Import
items.root_cause: Webhook delivery queue using in-memory buffer that loses events during pod restarts. Signature validation fails due to clock drift on some worker nodes.

items.name: API Performance and Rate Limiting Degradation
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in API
items.root_cause: Rate limiter config using fixed window instead of sliding window algorithm causing burst traffic to exhaust quota prematurely. Event stream processor has insufficient consumer capacity.

items.name: CRM Data Synchronization Failures
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in CRM, Webhook
items.root_cause: CRM sync worker encountering deadlock on concurrent contact record updates. The merge tool creates duplicate records when profiles are updated simultaneously from multiple sources.

items.name: Portfolio Analytics Calculation Errors
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in Product Bug
items.root_cause: Market data feed parser using incorrect date format for international exchanges. Valuation model not handling multiple share classes correctly.

items.name: Client Portal and LP Reporting Performance Issues
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in Client, Portfolio
items.root_cause: Client portal backend queries missing pagination limits for LP account data. Statement generation service blocked by shared database connection pool exhaustion.

items.name: OCR Document Processing Pipeline Degradation
items.summary: Pattern detected: 4 related tickets in OCR Processing, Risk Assessment, Document Review
items.root_cause: OCR worker service memory leak in PDF parsing library. Worker pod runs out of memory after processing ~200 pages causing cascading failures.

items.name: Recurring Financial Report Generation Failures
items.summary: Pattern detected: 5 related tickets in Financial Report, NAV Calculation
items.root_cause: Portfolio aggregation pipeline memory exhaustion due to missing index on holdings table. Report template rendering engine experiencing concurrent session limits.
